# pump-kit
> TypeScript SDK for Pump.fun built on Solana Kit 8.4.

Canonical docs: `README.md`
Testing guide: `TESTING.md`
WSOL guide: `WRAPPING.md`
Machine-readable action registry: `metadata/actions-registry.json`

Entry points:
- `pump-kit` (full API)
- `pump-kit/simple` (minimal API)
- `pump-kit/launch` (launch sessions and low-level bonding-curve v2 instructions; excludes AMM swap builders)
- `pump-kit/launch/store` (durable filesystem records for Node/Bun)

Agent integration notes:
- For launches with external swap routing, use `createPump` from `pump-kit/launch` and omit `firstBuy`.
- Upload token metadata before preparing; provide its URI in the launch config.
- A new coin's CA is its mint address. All launch APIs require your supplied mint signer and never generate a token address. Pass expectedMint as an optional mismatch guard; CLI requires --mint-keypair for setup/dry-run/run and accepts --mint-address as a guard or address-only preview.
- Reuse the same mint keypair for preview, setup, dry-run, and run. Dry-run verifies signatures and never broadcasts; atomic mode requires an existing lookup table.
- Supply a durable `saveRecord` callback before broadcast and reconcile uncertain signatures before any retry.
- Set priority fees and instruction hooks on `PrepareLaunchOptions`; atomic first-buy simulation requires an active lookup table.
- IDL provenance is recorded in `idl/manifest.json`; update with `bun run idl:update`.
- Pass slippage in basis points (`slippageBps`), not percent.
- For swap helpers, use either explicit lamport limits or estimate+`slippageBps` mode; do not mix modes.
- JSON transports should encode bigint values as decimal strings and cast with `BigInt(...)` before calling SDK functions.
- Provide `bondingCurveCreator`/`poolCreator` when known to avoid extra RPC lookups.

High-value actions:
- `createPump().launch.validate`, `.prepare`; session `.setup`, `.simulate`, `.send`
- `createV2`, `buyV2`, `sellV2`, `buyExactQuoteInV2`
- `reconcileLaunchRecord`, `createFileLaunchStore`
- `curveBuy`, `curveSell`
- `ammBuy`, `ammSell`
- `addLiquidity`, `removeLiquidity`
- `mintWithFirstBuy`, `createAndBuy`
- `buildTransaction`, `sendAndConfirmTransaction`, `simulateTransaction`
